TIEBA_DIY_RELIC_BAGUETTE.title: Baguette
TIEBA_DIY_RELIC_BAGUETTE.description: At the start of each turn, gain {Energy:energyIcons()}. On turn [blue]3[/blue], then lose {EnergyLoss:energyIcons()}.
TIEBA_DIY_RELIC_BROKEN_POCKETWATCH.title: Broken Pocketwatch
TIEBA_DIY_RELIC_BROKEN_POCKETWATCH.descr: Whenever you play [blue]{CardThreshold}[/blue] or fewer {CardThreshold:plural:card|cards} during your turn, draw [blue]{Cards}[/blue] additional {Cards:plural:card|cards} at the start of your next turn.
TIEBA_DIY_RELIC_BROKEN_POCKETWATCH.flavo: Even broken, it is right twice a day.
TIEBA_DIY_RELIC_UNHATCHED_EMBER.title: Unhatched Ember
TIEBA_DIY_RELIC_UNHATCHED_EMBER.descript: Once per combat, when you die, revive with [blue]1[/blue] HP. You cannot die for the rest of this turn.
TIEBA_DIY_RELIC_UNHATCHED_EMBER.flavor: Something beneath the shell is waiting to take its first breath.
